resources.string: Hold the phone\'s mic within a few cm of the miner\'s fans, keep the room quiet, and record a %1$d-second clip. The audio is analysed on-device (FFT) and never saved or sent. This is a best-effort, indicative check — not a calibrated diagnostic.
